Hello,
I like this idea of clash, I want to see it in a real clash against other codingamers.
To do it in reverse mode wouldbe very fun.
But, with seing the rules, I think it can be funny too to play it in code size mode, because there are to any way to solve this problem and I think it should be to play it in the two mods.

When you'll need to get three agreements, send a commet under this one and I'll give you my agreement because I really love this idea of puzzle

Constraints
* [[R]] is undefined.

Cases
* Test 3: Consider using 31 and 38 instead of 51 and 58 in the input.

* Test 6 and Validator 6 are the same. Please revise Validator 6 so that it's a bit different.

Thanks.
Now I understand "validator must be related (in terms of content)", thank you for the review

Hi 👋 ! Thanks for your comment, it's encouraging for sure. Ok I can extend it to the Shortest mode which I guess is the code size mode you were talking about. Tell me, if it's not the case I'll modify it adequately.
Yes, that, and also it's better that "+" has its own pair of cases and is introduced earlier, particularly so for Reverse mode.
